nieuw.titel: Judge units by how they earn or preserve points
nieuw.tekst: When comparing units and army entries, decide what each unit will do on the battlefield and how it helps kill enemy units or keep your own alive.

bronnen.citaat: just ask yourself what will this unit do on the battlefield

extraCitaten.citaat: units and keep my stuff alive

nieuw.titel: Use gunlines to score while denying enemy contact
nieuw.tekst: Use a gunline's missile attacks and artillery to earn victory points from across the board while keeping the enemy from engaging your units.
nieuw.waarom: He calls preventing enemy contact the best way to deny points, and says scoring at range forces the opponent to rush towards you.

bronnen.citaat: use your artillery pieces to take out units from across the board

extraCitaten.citaat: denying your opponent points is to not let them ever touch you
your opponent immediately has to start rushing towards you

nieuw.titel: Use speed to shut gunlines down quickly
nieuw.tekst: Against a gunline, use a fast army to cross the board and close it down before it does too much damage.
nieuw.waarom: He says an army that can reach and shut down a gunline quickly will be good against it.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He cautions that the same fast armies probably lack the durability and hitting power of infantry units.

bronnen.citaat: get across the board fast and close a gun line down

extraCitaten.citaat: those same fast armies probably aren't going to be as survivable as Punchy

bron.citaat: they might be able to redirect them

extraCitaten.citaat: use their big expensive units to kill little things that aren't very valuable

aanvullingen.toelichting: He likewise recommends using cheap chaff to occupy and redirect expensive enemy units, creating more favourable engagements.
